name: aaron_marketing_skills
description: An integrated set of 120 AI-powered marketing skills organized into 8 specialized bot roles across 7 marketing disciplines, offering a contract-based marketing service with 8 audit gates to ensure quality and performance in campaigns.

inputs.name: marketing_objective
inputs.description: The main marketing goal to achieve, e.g., brand awareness, lead generation, or product launch.

inputs.name: target_audience_data
inputs.description: Demographic, behavioral, and geographic data defining the target audience.

inputs.name: content_assets
inputs.description: Marketing content such as narratives, SEO keywords, social posts, email drafts, paid ads, influencer outlines, or launch plans.

inputs.name: performance_metrics
inputs.description: Metrics related to engagement, conversion, ROAS, and other KPIs for auditing marketing activities.

outputs.name: marketing_strategy
outputs.description: A comprehensive strategy covering narrative, SEO/GEO, social media, email, paid advertising, influencer marketing, and launch plans.

outputs.name: audit_report
outputs.description: Evaluation reports from auditor gates: TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, RAMP assessing quality and effectiveness.

outputs.name: actionable_recommendations
outputs.description: Suggestions and improvements for ongoing marketing campaigns and content.

steps: Define marketing objectives and gather audience data
Generate or refine content assets across key marketing disciplines using AI bots
Execute coordinated marketing activities including narrative, SEO/GEO, social, email, paid, influencer, and launch campaigns
Apply auditor gates (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, STAR, RAMP) to assess content quality and campaign performance
Compile audit reports and derive actionable recommendations
Iterate marketing efforts based on audit feedback and performance analytics
use_cases: Deploying a comprehensive AI marketing team to plan and execute multi-channel campaigns
Auditing and improving existing marketing strategies and content quality
Automating end-to-end marketing workflow with AI-powered specialized bots
Scaling marketing efforts using a portable skill set across industries and products
Contracting AI marketing expertise for short or long-term marketing projects
patterns: Modular AI bot roles specialized by marketing disciplines
Use of auditor gates for continuous quality and performance auditing
Skill portability across projects and teams

prompt_templates.name: generate_narrative
prompt_templates.template: Create a compelling marketing narrative for the product targeting {target_audience} focusing on {key_benefits}.

prompt_templates.name: seo_optimization
prompt_templates.template: Generate SEO and GEO keywords and content suggestions to improve search rankings for {market_segment}.

prompt_templates.name: social_media_campaign
prompt_templates.template: Develop a social media campaign plan tailored for {platforms} to increase engagement among {target_audience}.

prompt_templates.name: email_marketing_sequence
prompt_templates.template: Create an email marketing sequence for {campaign_purpose} including subject lines, body content, and CTAs.

prompt_templates.name: paid_ad_strategy
prompt_templates.template: Recommend a paid advertising strategy with budget allocation and targeting criteria for {product}.

prompt_templates.name: influencer_marketing_plan
prompt_templates.template: Outline an influencer marketing plan targeting {influencer_types} to promote {brand}.

prompt_templates.name: launch_plan
prompt_templates.template: Develop a step-by-step launch plan for {product_or_service} including timelines and key activities.

prompt_templates.name: audit_gate_evaluation
prompt_templates.template: Evaluate marketing materials against the {gate_name} audit criteria and provide improvement suggestions.
